title: Rocky Racoon
lyrics_synced:
[00:08.12] Now somewhere in the black mountain hills
[00:10.06] of Dakota there lived a young boy named
[00:12.53] Rocky Raccoon and one day his woman ran off
[00:16.59] with another guy!
[00:18.35] Hit young Rocky in the eye Rocky didn't like that!
[00:21.88] He said I'm gonna get that boy!
[00:24.88] So one day he walked into town!
[00:26.82] Booked himself a room in the local saloon.
[00:31.06] Rocky Raccoon checked into his room
[00:36.71] only to find Gideon's bible!
[00:42.18] Rocky had come equipped with a gun
[00:47.65] to shoot off the legs of his rival!
[00:53.29] His rival it seems had broken his dreams
[00:58.94] by stealing the girl of his fancy!
[01:04.59] Her name was Magil and she called herself Lil!
[01:10.24] But everyone knew her as Nancy.
[01:15.88] Now she and her man who called himself Dan
[01:21.53] were in the next room at the hoe down.
[01:27.53] Rocky burst in and grinning a grin!
[01:32.65] He said Danny boy this is a showdown!
[01:38.82] But Daniel was hot, he drew first and shot
[01:44.12] and Rocky collapsed in the corner!
[02:12.18] Now the doctor came in stinking of gin
[02:17.82] and proceeded to lie on the table.
[02:23.47] He said Rocky you met your match
[02:26.29] and Rocky said, Doc it's only a scratch!
[02:29.12] And I'll be better I'll be better
[02:31.06] doc as soon as I am able!
[02:34.76] Now Rocky Raccoon he fell back in his room
[02:40.94] only to find Gideon's bible!
[02:46.59] Gideon checked out and he left it no doubt
[02:51.88] to help with good Rocky's revival.
